lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the base plate (outer skin 1) to flange 3/4 fold, about 90 deg. In the perpendicular sections at x=-70, 0 and +70 the apex sits on the outer-skin arc at the bisector, (-48.4,-4.1) in the PCA frame. Measured at 25 stations, the apex is 0.01 to 0.35 mm from the nearest outer-surface point, which is within the 0.72 mm voxel. The line runs parallel to the fold, from -144.1 to +144.2 mm, and the part runs from -145 to +145.2 mm, so it covers about 99% of the fold. The end close-ups confirm it reaches both flange ends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is the base plate (outer skin 1) to flange 5/6 fold, about 89-91 deg. In the sections at 25/50/75% the apex dot sits on the outer arc at the bisector, (48.9,-4.1). Measured at 25 stations, the apex is 0.02 to 0.20 mm from the outer surface. The line is parallel and runs from -144.0 to +144.3 mm against a part extent of -145 to +145.2 mm, about 99% coverage.
